connections.feedback: Los Angeles is a huge city in California. It is not the capital of the country. Try the city named for the first President.
New York City is very big and famous, but it is not the nation's capital. The capital is Washington, D.C.
Chicago is a big city on Lake Michigan. The country's leaders meet in a different city: Washington, D.C.
Yes! Washington, D.C. is the capital of the whole country. The President and Congress work there.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: The 48 touching states are only part of the story. Alaska and Hawaii are states too, so the total is 50.
That is too many. The United States has 50 states. Two of them, Alaska and Hawaii, are away from the others.
Close, but no. Some people count Washington, D.C., but it is not a state. The number of states is 50.
Right! There are 50 states. Washington, D.C. is a special city, not a state.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: San Antonio is a Texas city with a famous old mission, but the capital is Austin.
Dallas is a well-known Texas city, but the capital is a different one: Austin.
Yes! Austin is the capital of Texas. The state government works there.
Houston is a very big city in Texas, but it is not the capital. The capital is Austin.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: San Diego is a city near the Mexico border. The capital of California is a different city: Sacramento.
Los Angeles is the city many people think of first, but it is not the capital. The capital is Sacramento.
Correct! Sacramento is the capital of California. It is inland, not on the coast.
San Francisco is famous for its bridge, but it is not the capital. The capital is Sacramento.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Yes! Denver is the capital of Colorado. It is a big city near the Rocky Mountains.
Chicago is a big city in Illinois, but the capital of Illinois is Springfield.
Yes! Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, in the Northeast part of the country.
Los Angeles is not a state capital. California's capital is Sacramento.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Lake Michigan is one of the Great Lakes. A lake is a big body of water that stays in one place; a river flows.
The Rocky Mountains are tall mountains, not a river. Rivers are moving water.
The Mojave Desert is a dry place with very little rain, not a river.
Yes! The Mississippi River is a long river that flows through the middle of the country.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: The Mississippi is a river, not mountains. A river is water that flows downhill.
Lake Michigan is a lake, a big body of water. Mountains are tall, rocky land.
The Mojave is a desert, a dry area. A mountain chain is a row of tall peaks.
Right! The Rocky Mountains are a long chain of tall mountains in the western part of the country.

connections.feedback: West is to your left when you face north. Behind you is the opposite direction.
North is the way you are facing, so it is in front of you, not behind.
East is to your right when you face north. Behind you is the opposite direction.
Yes! South is the opposite of north. If you face north, south is behind you.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: Yes! If east is on your right, you are facing north. Picture facing the sunrise, then turning left.
If you walked south, the east would be on your left side, not your right.
If you walked east, you would be walking straight toward the sun, so it would be in front of you.
If you walked west, the sun would be behind you, not on your right side.

connections.feedback: Yes! Canada is north of most of the United States.
Brazil is a large country in South America, far to the south.
Mexico is south of the United States, not north.
Cuba is an island country in the warm Caribbean Sea to the south, not to the north.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Right! Mexico is just south of Texas. A river called the Rio Grande forms much of the border.
Canada is far to the north of Texas, along the top of the country.
Brazil is in South America, much farther away. It does not touch the United States.
Cuba is an island across the water. It does not touch Texas.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Montana is a large western state, but it has far less land than Alaska.
California is a big state along the Pacific coast, but it has less land than Alaska.
Texas is very big, and it is the second largest state, but Alaska has even more land.
Yes! Alaska has the most land of any state. It is much bigger than it looks on some maps.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: High mountains are cold. In January there is usually deep snow there.
The far north of Alaska is one of the coldest places in the country in January.
Northern Minnesota is far north and very cold in winter, with lots of snow.
Yes! Southern Florida is far south, so even in winter it stays warm.

connections.feedback: Bryce Canyon is a real park with tall rock towers, but it is in Utah, not Arizona.
Yellowstone is famous for geysers and hot springs, mostly in Wyoming.
Yes! The Grand Canyon is in Arizona. The Colorado River helped carve it over a very long time.
The Everglades is a huge wetland in Florida, not a canyon.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Texas is in the South region, in the southern part of the country.
Yes! Maine is in the Northeast region, in the far northeast corner of the country.
Oregon is in the West region, on the Pacific coast.
Ohio is in the Midwest region, which is in the middle-north of the country.

connections.feedback: The country has several time zones. New York and California are in different ones, so their clocks differ.
That is too big a difference. California is only 3 hours behind New York.
Yes! The sun reaches the east first, so clocks in the west show an earlier time. California is 3 hours behind New York.
Going west, the time gets earlier, not later. California is behind New York.

connections.feedback: No. Weather near water still changes. It can be windy and stormy.
Yes! Water and fish helped people live and eat.
Yes! Before trains and trucks, boats were a main way to move things.
No. There was never a rule like that. Many towns are far from any ocean.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Yes! Florida is far south of Chicago, so the family mostly drives south.
North would take them toward Canada, away from Florida.
West would take them toward the Rocky Mountains, away from Florida.
East would take them toward states like Ohio and Pennsylvania. Florida is mostly south of Chicago.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Alaska also has coast on the Pacific Ocean, but that is on its south and west sides, not the north.
The Indian Ocean is on the other side of the world, near Asia and Africa.
The Atlantic Ocean is on the eastern side of the country, far from Alaska's north coast.
Yes! The Arctic Ocean is the icy ocean at the top of the world, north of Alaska.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Yes! The key explains the symbols. For example, a blue line might mean a river.
Some maps show a date, but that is not what the key is for. The key explains symbols.
A map key does not list how many people live somewhere. It explains the map's symbols.
Wind direction is not in the key. The key tells what the map's symbols and colors mean.

connections.feedback: Yes! Lake Michigan is a lake, one of the five Great Lakes. It is a huge body of water with land all around it.
The Rocky Mountains are tall land, not water. A lake is water.
The Mojave is a dry desert. A lake is a large body of water.
The Mississippi is a river. A river flows from one place to another, like a long moving ribbon of water.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: The Mississippi is a river with lots of water, the opposite of a desert.
The Rocky Mountains are tall, and some places get snow. A desert is a dry place with little rain.
Right! The Mojave is a desert in the Southwest. Deserts get very little rain.
Lake Michigan is a huge lake full of water. A desert is a very dry place.

origin.author: READY builder

connections.feedback: Yes! Denver is the capital of Colorado. It is called the Mile High City because it sits high above sea level.
Los Angeles is a big city in California. Colorado's capital is Denver.
Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, in the Northeast. It is not in Colorado.
Chicago is a big city in Illinois, far to the east. It is not in Colorado.

origin.author: READY builder
origin.source_reference: Original draft material; not an official assessment; awaiting owner review

connections.feedback: Los Angeles is in California, on the opposite coast from Massachusetts.
Chicago is a big city in Illinois, in the middle of the country. Massachusetts is in the Northeast.
Denver is the capital of Colorado, far to the west. Massachusetts is on the Atlantic coast.
Yes! Boston is the capital of Massachusetts. It is also a busy port on the Atlantic coast.
